summary.text: James Sceniak is the Libertarian nominee for Indiana's 7th Congressional District and Vice Chair of the Libertarian Party of Indiana. He was the Libertarian nominee for U.S. Senate in 2022 and for Indiana's 6th District in 2024, and according to BallotReady he works as a behavior therapist.

paragraphs.text: According to his BallotReady profile, Sceniak earned a bachelor's degree in human services from Bethel College in 2012 and an associate degree in human resources from Ivy Tech Community College.

The same profile lists work as a registered behavior technician at the Applied Behavior Center for Autism from 2018 to 2020 and at Autism Companion Services from 2020 to 2023, and as lead registered behavior therapist at Centria Health Care from 2023 to the present. It also shows him on the November 2023 ballot for Greenwood City Council at-large.

Sceniak was the Libertarian nominee for U.S. Senate in 2022, receiving 3.4% of the vote (63,823 votes) behind Republican Todd Young and Democrat Thomas McDermott Jr. In 2024 he was the Libertarian nominee for Indiana's 6th District, receiving 4.4% (13,711 votes) in the race won by Jefferson Shreve.
He serves as Vice Chair of the Libertarian Party of Indiana and was nominated for the 7th District at the Libertarian convention on March 22, 2026.
